Hi, I am Xinyuan Huang, a postdoctoral researcher at the [Andlinger Center for Energy and the Environment](https://acee.princeton.edu) at [Princeton University](https://www.princeton.edu).

I work on modeling realistic global decarbonization pathways and energy system transitions, with a focus on how regional variations shape investment in low-carbon technologies across countries. I also study how mitigation policies affect air pollution, health burdens, and health inequities under future uncertainties using integrated assessment models.

I received my PhD in [Environmental Engineering](https://www.cee.psu.edu) from [Penn State University](https://www.psu.edu) and undergraduate degrees in chemistry and economics from [Peking University](https://www.pku.edu.cn). Prior to joining Penn State, I worked as a data scientist at SF Express, the largest logistics company in China.

## Research Interests

- Energy systems and integrated assessment modeling
- Air pollution and health impacts
- Environmental justice
- Realistic modeling of decarbonization
